x_konark_024: The Sun Temple at Konark was built in the 13th century under King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty. It was conceived as the colossal chariot of Surya, the sun god, drawn by horses on twenty-four carved stone wheels.
x_konark_025: Each wheel is covered in fine carving, and the wheels are often described as sundials, their spokes marking the hours of the day.
